candidate.model: contr_final.pt of processed/effects_contr_2026-10-04 (phase-2 fit on all 8 groups, 100 steps = median best step of the folds), read back by sha256

candidate.gate: common share of the correction before centring <= 0.5 in every context, else no upload

against_t31: not a single factor: the model's direction, the effect definition in d space with the amplitude matched in d instead of lfc, and the exclusion of unexpressed genes (plus effects on expressed genes K562 does not measure) change together; sources, covered targets, generator and effects scale are the same

expected.calibration: Subjective. The bench gain (+0.015 cosine on a base near 0.1) is small and local benches overstated the site three times (t28, t31 of this branch, Davide's t30); the change of effect definition may move the score either way by a few thousandths.

rule.c_loss_at_least_0.005: t34 - t31 <= -0.005: harmful on the official contexts despite the bench; the effect-level line stops until the mechanism is named
rule.also_reported: the six scaled members against t31, and which members move
